doc.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001

title: Life on the road
summary: Brief talk of traveling to new towns and good and bad hotels.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: What was it like traveling on the road at that time?

Great. You’d go into towns that you’d never been to. You know, like our band, we’ll stay in Storage Roach Motel and then we’ll stay at the Trump Plaza and they’ve all got phones in their rooms and then they complain. I says, “listen, keep this in your mind where we just stayed so when we stay at the Roach Motel, remember where we stayed and be happy.” But all the bands did it. Basie, Woody, Duke. You get the good and you get the bad. But we love to do what we do.
